about.title: About Quadri Medical & General Store
about.subtitle: A landmark of trust, care, and quality healthcare in Himmatpura, Hyderabad for 30 years.
about.storyHeading: Three Decades of Serving Our Community
about.storyParagraph1: Established with a foundational mission to make authentic medications and dependable healthcare products readily accessible, Quadri Medical & General Store has been a cornerstone of Himmatpura, Hyderabad for over 30 years.
about.storyParagraph2: Over the past three decades, medical science and retail have evolved, but our core pledge has remained constant: prioritizing patient health above all else. Every tablet, syrup, and healthcare product on our shelves is procured exclusively from verified distributors to guarantee genuine efficacy.
about.storyParagraph3: We believe a medical store is not merely a retail outlet, but an essential community resource. Our experienced staff takes time to understand your needs, explain dosage instructions carefully, and ensure you receive the right care for your loved ones.
about.missionText: To safeguard our community’s well-being by providing 100% authentic medicines, accessible prices, transparent advice, and respectful, personalized service to every customer who walks through our doors.
about.pharmacistMessage: “Your health and trust are our most valuable assets. Whether you need an urgent prescription or everyday health essentials, our doors and phone lines are always open to assist you.”

services.title: Prescription Medicines
services.shortDescription: Allopathic branded and generic prescription medications dispensed with precision by experienced professionals.
services.fullDescription: We stock a comprehensive inventory of doctor-prescribed medications across cardiology, diabetology, neurology, pediatrics, dermatology, and general medicine. All medicines are stored under strict temperature-controlled standards.

services.title: Over-the-Counter (OTC) Medicines
services.shortDescription: Safe, verified remedies for cold, fever, cough, acidity, headache, allergies, and minor pain relief.
services.fullDescription: Quick access to reliable OTC remedies for routine ailments. Our staff is ready to help explain appropriate dosages, indications, and precautions for safe home recovery.

services.title: General Healthcare Products
services.shortDescription: Vitamins, minerals, nutritional supplements, immunity boosters, and diabetic-friendly nutritional essentials.
services.fullDescription: Support your daily energy and vitality with certified multivitamins, calcium supplements, protein powders, herbal wellness items, and specialized dietary products for all age groups.

services.title: Personal Care & Hygiene
services.shortDescription: Dermatological skin care, antiseptic soaps, oral hygiene, shampoos, and daily personal grooming products.
services.fullDescription: Comprehensive selection of personal hygiene and skincare brands, medicated cleansers, moisturizers, dental care, hand sanitizers, and daily grooming supplies.

services.title: Baby Care & Mother Care
services.shortDescription: Baby formulas, diapers, gentle wipes, feeding bottles, baby skincare, and postpartum maternal wellness.
services.fullDescription: Trusted pediatrician-recommended baby care essentials, baby nutrition, feeding accessories, gentle lotions, diaper rash creams, and maternal health aids.

services.title: First Aid & Surgical Supplies
services.shortDescription: Antiseptic liquids, sterile bandages, gauze, surgical tapes, cotton, crepe bandages, and burn dressings.
services.fullDescription: Equip your home, office, or vehicle with essential first-aid necessities. We carry medical-grade dressing materials, antiseptic solutions (Dettol, Betadine), and emergency wound care products.

services.title: Health Monitoring Devices
services.shortDescription: Digital BP monitors, pulse oximeters, blood glucose meters, test strips, and digital thermometers.
services.fullDescription: Accurate, simple-to-use at-home diagnostic equipment. We help you choose the right monitoring device and supply replacement strips, lancets, and batteries.

services.title: Daily General Store Essentials
services.shortDescription: Oral rehydration salts, energy drinks, sanitizers, household wellness items, and daily lifestyle sundries.
services.fullDescription: Convenient general-store essentials so you can pick up daily items together with your medical prescriptions in one convenient neighborhood stop.
